task: Implement the privilege separated signer per docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-12-privilege-separated-signer.md: bigint safe wire codec, policy validator, signer process, socket wallet, purser-signer binary with hardened systemd unit, and wire the daemon to it end to end.
constraints: No em-dashes anywhere: code, comments, docs, commit messages.
The signer must never sign a caller supplied digest. Structured typed data only.
Refusal codes are stable lowercase snake_case, matching the GateRefusedError convention.
Optimise token use, never simplify: do not cut validation, error handling or test coverage to save output.
